outputs.explanation: Panel A is a micrograph/spatial cluster map, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows H&E micrographs with manual annotations, not a data plot.
Panel C includes spatial transcriptomic expression maps overlaid on tissue (heatmap-like per-spot expression), not a bar/summary chart requiring individual point overlay.
Panel D consists of GSEA enrichment line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.

Panel E is a bar graph of log2 fold-change values per gene derived from differential expression statistical testing (Wilcoxon rank-sum with Bonferroni correction across all spots), not a mean of a small set of replicate measurements, so there are no discrete individual data points to overlay.
